rows.name: Werebear
rows.notes: Bear head/ears/muzzle, visible eyes/open mouth, forepaws/claws, brown fur and rustic vest replace the stitched humanoid. Returned for hidden eyes/teddy-bear face and weak claws. Still chunky segmented fur, exaggerated fangs and simplified limb/clothing junctions.

rows.name: Hobgoblin Marshal
rows.notes: Pointed ears/red-brown face, plain steel helmet, layered armor/green cloak, held map board and command saber replace the generic green brute. Returned for flat cap, insufficient armor and short/misaligned saber. Schematic map, rigid cloth and faceted anatomy remain first-pass.

rows.name: Ash Demon
rows.notes: Winged charcoal demon with horns, ragged ember membranes, claws, tail, orange fissures, shoulder flames and faint soot replaces the clean imp. Returned for brown body/pale cracks and uniform wings. Solid segmented body, static tail/wing panels and weak smoke remain well short of the swirling source fire/soot anatomy.
